subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Make vs. Buy Decisions
description: A quick, practical guide to Make vs. Buy Decisions.

hook.text: Apple designs its own chips but buys screens from Samsung. Making everything in-house isn't always smart.

buildup.text: The make-or-buy decision asks: should we produce this ourselves or buy it from a supplier?

discovery.text: Make when it's a core competency or secret. Buy when suppliers can do it cheaper, faster, or better.

twist.text: Outsourcing saves money but creates dependency. If your sole supplier fails, you can't make it yourself.

climax.text: The best companies make what differentiates them and buy everything else from specialists.

punchline.text: Make what makes you special. Buy the rest.

quiz.question: When should a company typically 'make' instead of 'buy'?
options: When it's a core competency or trade secret
